about.title: Founded in 1999, out of a portable building and an enclosed trailer.
text: Troop Industrial started out as a small fastener supplier working out of a portable building at the owner's house, pulling an enclosed trailer from job to job. Through hard work and perseverance, Troop Industrial has grown to a thriving industrial fastener supply house with three locations covering the industrial Texas and Louisiana Gulf Coast.

We have become a reliable supplier of stud bolts in a myriad of grades and coatings, gaskets of all types, structural bolts and related hardware, wire rope, chain, safety supplies, tape, flagging, chemicals, degreasers, drill bits and anything else a customer would need at a job site, capital project, fabrication facility or machine shop.

It is no coincidence that Troop is the name of our business. Our President and CEO, Brian Swindel, is a U.S. Marine Corps combat veteran, and his pride for our nation's veterans and armed services is at the core of our team values. We are a veteran-owned business in Texas and Louisiana, and we support veteran based non-profits every month and throughout the year.

For over 20 years, Troop has earned the trust of steel fabricators, industrial contractors, EPC contractors, MRO facilities and engineers who rely on quality in products and performance. We serve the industrial Gulf Coast and all of North America.
